display.purpose: Page-level titles with Geist 600 and tight tracking (-0.04em).

title.purpose: Section titles and panel headings with Geist 600 and -0.03em tracking.

body.purpose: Primary reading text and long-form copy.

label.purpose: Form labels, nav, buttons, and chrome meta at 0.875rem.

mono.purpose: Addresses, hashes, IDs, and code-like data only.

shadows.name: border-medium
shadows.purpose: Mid elevation for cards that need a quiet lift.

shadows.name: border-large
shadows.purpose: Larger quiet lift for prominent panels.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Hover/focus color and border transitions only—no bounce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Near-black primary action with soft 6px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #171717; background: #171717; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 40px; font: 400 0.875rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0a0a0a; border-color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0072F5; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #171717; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White elevated control with soft border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #EAEAEA; background: #ffffff; color: #171717; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 40px; font: 400 0.875rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #EBEBEB; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0072F5; outline: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent chrome control with soft hover fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #4D4D4D; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 40px; font: 400 0.875rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #EBEBEB; color: #171717; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0072F5; outline: none; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact recessed pill for status and meta.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #F2F2F2; color: #171717; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 400 0.75rem/1.33 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #45A557; }

components.name: Content Panel
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #ffffff; color: #171717; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); font: 400 1rem/1.5 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-panel p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #666666; }

components.name: Muted Panel
components.css: .ds-panel-muted { background: #F2F2F2; color: #171717; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-muted p { margin: 0; color: #666666; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Elevated field with soft border and double-ring focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #171717; } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #EAEAEA; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #171717; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8F8F8F; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #D4D4D4; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0072F5; border-color: #0072F5; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar row with soft hover and active fill.
components.html: OverviewMarketplace
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; color: #4D4D4D; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #EBEBEB; color: #171717; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: #EBEBEB; color: #171717; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0072F5; }

narrative.overview:
The Node Marketplace prototype speaks Vercel’s Operate language: an achromatic canvas where hierarchy comes from weight, spacing, and soft edges—not ornament. Geist carries every UI string; Geist Mono is reserved for addresses, hashes, and code-like data. Blue is the only interactive accent. Status greens, ambers, and reds appear as compact indicators or soft-tinted badges, never as decorative fills.

Personality is developer-tool quiet confidence. Screens should feel engineered and scannable—sidebar nav with soft hover fills, elevated white panels edged by shadow-as-border, primary actions in near-black. Density is comfortable (~40px controls) rather than sparse marketing whitespace or cramped wireframe tables.

Confirmed rejection: Relume hard-black square wireframe as the identity, purple/glow crypto dashboards, multi-layer colored soft-UI shadows, and decorative gradients.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic #FAFAFA canvas with elevated white panels
Geist 400/500/600 only; Geist Mono for data
Shadow-as-border elevation and double-ring blue focus
Soft 6–12px radii; pill radius for badges and status dots
Boxicons outline by default; filled only for active nav

rules.name: The Blue Economy Rule
rules.body: Blue is for links, focus, and interactive emphasis—never large decorative fills. Audit: if blue occupies more than a thin control or text run, remove it.

rules.name: The Indicator Scale Rule
rules.body: Status color stays at ~10px dots or compact badges; soft tints (success-soft, error-soft) wrap only small status chips, not full-width banners unless the product state truly requires interruption.

rules.name: The Three-Weight Rule
rules.body: Use 400, 500, and 600 only. Do not introduce 700 for hierarchy—size and spacing carry emphasis.

rules.name: The Mono Reservation Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for machine-readable strings only, never for marketing headlines or body prose.

rules.name: The Soft Edge Rule
rules.body: Prefer #EAEAEA borders and shadow-as-border over hard black Relume frames.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Ambient shadow appears only for floating layers (menus, sheets) or focus—not as a default card glow.

rules.name: The Control Radius Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls default to 6px; content panels default to 12px. Do not mix square Relume geometry into new surfaces.

dos: Do compose Operate screens from soft-bordered elevated panels on #FAFAFA.
Do use Geist with the three-weight rule (400/500/600) and tight display/title tracking (-0.03em to -0.04em).
Do keep primary actions near-black and secondary actions bordered white.
Do reserve blue for links, focus, and interactive emphasis.
Do use Boxicons; outline by default, filled for active navigation.
donts: Don't restore Relume square ink-border wireframe as the default look.
Don't paint large purple/blue gradient surfaces or multi-layer colored glow shadows.
Don't turn status colors into full-width alert banners unless the product state truly requires interruption.
Don't use Geist Mono for UI chrome copy or marketing headlines.
